name: zclass_sequence_update
description: zClass_Sequence::Update advances sequence time, steps across entry triggers, clamps or wraps at bounds, flips direction when not wrapping, and deactivates when repeat-at-bounds is disabled.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this sequence helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass sequence/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x4541c0 validates null-node and null-class-data error returns, paused/inactive early exits, frame delta accumulation, repeated trigger stepping, clamp/wrap bounds handling, step reversal, and repeat-at-bounds deactivation.
The native smoke covers the same observable state transitions, including multi-entry stepping and both upper and lower bound paths.
